what: 3.3 Focal Buffer Zonal Analysis with d4h_indicator_buffer()
title: Case 04 - GPS House Buffers & Proximity to Water
text: d4h_indicator_buffer() accelerates computation cropping drone orthomosaic strictly envelope intersecting household buffers. computes requested indicator (NDVI), extracts grid summaries, renders automated visualization: Buffer Distance=radius×cell_size\text{Buffer Distance} = \text{radius} \times \text{cell\_size}
code: # Execute focal buffer analysis (150m buffer = 3 cells of 50m) res_buffer <- d4h_indicator_buffer(   indicator        = "NDVI",   houses           = houses_file,   radius           = 3,             # 3 grid units   cell_size        = 50,            # 50m cell size -> 150m buffer radius   radius_in_meters = FALSE,   nir              = path_nir,   red              = path_r,   square           = FALSE,         # Hexagonal grid within buffer   mask_outside     = TRUE,          # Masks non-focal areas outside buffer   house_color      = "red",   house_size       = 2.5,   palette          = "viridis",   limits           = c(0.1, 0.9),   title            = "Peridomestic Vector Flight Radius (150m) - Focal Canopy NDVI",   plot             = TRUE )  # Inspect focal zonal statistics head(res_buffer$grid)

what: 3.4 Distance to Water Calculation & Proximity Scoring
title: Case 04 - GPS House Buffers & Proximity to Water
text: Using segmented water bodies flight footprint, d4h_distance_to_water() measures minimum Euclidean distance (dmind_{\text{min}}) household closest water body calculates exponential proximity score: ProximityScorei=exp⁡(−dmin()λ)\text{ProximityScore}_i = \exp\left(-\frac{d_{\text{min}}()}{\lambda}\right) λ\lambda represents characteristic dispersal radius vector mosquitoes (e.g., λ=100 m\lambda = 100\text{ m} Aedes aegypti 150 m150\text{ m} Anopheles):
code: # 1. Segment water bodies from spectral indices r_ndwi <- d4h_ndwi(green = path_g, nir = path_nir) water_sf <- d4h_segment_water(   raster_in            = r_ndwi,   threshold            = 0.0,   is_ndwi              = TRUE,   max_water_brightness = 95.0,   min_area_m2          = 2.0 )  # 2. Extract household spatial features from the buffer result casas_sf <- res_buffer$houses  # 3. Calculate Euclidean distance and vector proximity scores water_proximity_sf <- d4h_distance_to_water(   buildings        = casas_sf,   sources          = water_sf,   decay_lambda     = 100.0,   buffer_breaks    = c(50, 100, 200),   proximity_labels = c("Immediate Proximity (<50m)", "High Proximity (50-100m)", "Moderate Proximity (100-200m)", "Distal (>200m)") )  # Inspect household distance metrics and proximity tiers head(as.data.frame(water_proximity_sf[, c("dist_water_m", "nearest_water_id", "proximity_score", "proximity_level")]))

Used map vegetative shading canopy roosting habitats adult mosquito vectors. Land Cover & Substrate Masks: Classify discrete land surface substrates bare soil (d4h_bare_soil()) delineate unpaved roads, exposed earth, peridomestic clearing boundaries. Hydrological & Micro-Pooling Detection: Identify open water surfaces, irrigation trenches, standing moisture pools (d4h_ndwi()) provide aquatic breeding habitats. Micro-Topography & Terrain Wetness: Model terrain slope (d4h_slope()) topographic wetness accumulation (d4h_twi()) UAV Digital Elevation Models (DEM/DSM) pinpoint natural drainage sinks runoff depressions. Eco-Epidemiological Risk Modeling: Synthesize multi-band metrics locate solid waste micro-accumulations (d4h_imsr()), hydric stagnation risk (d4h_irhe(), d4h_iev()), thermal micro-climate refuges (d4h_irts()), human-forest ecotone interfaces (d4h_irih(), d4h_ifeb()). Spatial Zonation & Surveillance Grids: Tessellate flight footprint operational hexagonal grids (d4h_hex_grid()) compute zonal summaries (d4h_summarize_grid()) community health teams larviciding logistics. Executive Reporting & Excel Export: Generate multi-moment descriptive statistics, spatial surface coverage hectares, Tukey outlier diagnostics automated multi-sheet Excel workbook export (d4h_executive_summary(), d4h_export_summary()). title: Segment Water Bodies and Surface Moisture Pools — d4h_segment_water
text: Water bodies extracted using two alternative methodologies: Spectral Thresholding (method = "spectral"): Combines negative NDVI positive NDWI signatures optical darkness constraint: $$\text{WaterMask} = \begin{cases} 1 & \text{} (\text{NDWI} > \theta_{\text{water}} \text{ } \text{NDVI} < \theta_{\text{veg}}) \text{ } \text{Brightness} \le \theta_{\text{dark}} \\ 0 & \text{otherwise} \end{cases}$$ Automatic Detection: is_ndwi = NULL (default), function inspects layer name filepath. NDWI/water index detected, applies \(\text{threshold} = 0.0\) (\(> 0\)); NDVI/vegetation index detected, applies \(\text{threshold} = -0.05\) (\(< -0.05\)). Users can explicitly override is_ndwi = TRUE/FALSE threshold. Deep Learning (method = "sam"): Utilizes Meta's Segment Anything Model (SAM) via reticulate. Operates natural visible RGB imagery (rgb_raster) delineate precise morphological water boundaries. Spectral parameters (threshold, is_ndwi, max_water_brightness) bypassed favor visual feature extraction, filtering candidates exclusively min_area_m2, max_area_m2, exclude_buildings. Model weights (sam_checkpoint) automatically resolved cached locally first use. Extracted pixel clusters converted vector polygons (sf), calculated surface area (\(\text{m}^2\)) perimeter.
